component_rules: Keep platform font alias selection in one pure application helper.
Keep exact OOXML font-attribute adaptation in one preview-only DOCX package helper.
Reuse the existing LibreOffice executable discovery, isolated profile, process cleanup, PDF validation, and atomic replacement path.
Preserve renderer-owned DOCX style parts once in the shared safe Office refresh boundary.
Do not copy macOS font aliases into the DOCX Renderer, template loader, Web adapter, Tauri adapter, or frontend.
